title: Elizabeth Debicki Says ‘Tenet’ Co-Star Robert Pattinson Will Be the ‘Perfect’ James Bond: ‘I’m So Thrilled’
content:
Elizabeth Debickiis weighing in on her “Tenet” co-starRobert Pattinsonbecoming the nextJames Bond.

“I’m so happy for Rob,” said Debicki at the Los Angeles premiere of “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.” When asked why Pattinson will make the perfect Bond, she responded: “He is an enigma himself. He’s beautiful, and he’s funny, and he’s smart… I think he’s perfect. I’m so thrilled.”

Debicki also added that “he’s evolved so much as an actor. He’s made really interesting choices. He’s really smart.”

Debicki and Pattinson co-starred in Christopher Nolan’s 2020 sci-fi action film “Tenet” alongside John David Washington, Dimple Kapadia, Michael Caine, and Kenneth Branagh.

Amazon MGM announced Monday morning thatPattinson landed the roleof 007 in the upcoming Bond film being directed by Denis Villeneuve

“James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime,” Pattinson said in a statement. “I’m deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team.”

Amy Pascal, who has produced the “Spider-Man” franchise and several 007 films, and David Heyman, behind the “Harry Potter” series, are producing the new Bond film, with Tanya Lapointe executive producing. Steven Knight is writing the screenplay.

“Before anything else, I want to express my deep gratitude to the remarkable actors who joined us on this journey,” Villeneuve said. “We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007. I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin.”
title_zh: 伊莉莎白·德比基(Elizabeth Debicki)表示《天能》(Tenet)的合作演員羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)將會是“完美的”詹姆斯·邦德(James Bond)：“我非常興奮”。
content_zh:
伊莉莎白·德比基(Elizabeth Debicki)對她的《天能》(Tenet) 共演者羅伯·派丁森(Robert Pattinson) 成為下一任詹姆斯·邦德(James Bond) 表達了看法。

“我為羅伯感到非常高興，”德比基在洛杉磯《克里夫·布斯的進一步錯誤冒險》(The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth) 首映式上表示。當被問及為何派丁森會成為完美的邦德時，她回答道：“他本身就是一個謎。他既美麗又幽默，還很聰明……我認為他是完美的。我感到非常興奮。”

德比基還補充說：“他作為演員的進步非常大。他做出了非常有趣的選擇。他真的很聰明。”

德比基和派丁森在克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan) 2020 年的科幻動作片《天能》(Tenet) 中共同演出，還有約翰·大衛·華盛頓(John David Washington)、丁普爾·卡帕迪亞(Dimple Kapadia)、邁克爾·凱恩(Michael Caine) 和肯尼斯·布拉納(Kenneth Branagh)。

亞馬遜MGM(Amazon MGM) 週一早上宣布，派丁森已獲得即將上映的邦德電影中的007角色，該片由丹尼斯·維倫紐瓦(Denis Villeneuve) 執導。

“詹姆斯·邦德是電影史上最具傳奇色彩的角色之一，能夠被委以007的重任是我一生中的榮幸，”派丁森在聲明中表示。“我對丹尼斯、艾米(Amy)、大衛(David)、塔尼亞(Tanya) 以及亞馬遜MGM工作室的每一位人員對我的信任深表感激。說這個角色是夢想成真有些輕描淡寫。我對這次合作和未來的工作感到無比興奮，與這支出色的團隊一起。”

艾米·帕斯卡(Amy Pascal) 曾製作《蜘蛛人》(Spider-Man) 系列和幾部007電影，大衛·海曼(David Heyman) 則是《哈利·波特》(Harry Potter) 系列的製作人，兩人共同製作這部新的邦德電影，塔尼亞·拉波因特(Tanya Lapointe) 擔任執行製片人。史蒂文·奈特(Steven Knight) 則負責編寫劇本。

“在開始之前，我想對參與這段旅程的卓越演員們表達我深深的感激，”維倫紐瓦說。“我們被非凡的才華所包圍，但只有一位007。我非常高興迎來羅伯·派丁森作為我們的新詹姆斯·邦德。他擁有007的永恆靈魂，並帶來了全新的精神。我迫不及待想要開始。”
